⚽ Step 2: Enter Match Details for Selected Teams

Heuristic: transparent hand-picked weights on form/goals. Poisson: proper probabilities derived from each side's expected-goals rate. Market Odds: uses live bookmaker prices where available (arguably the strongest signal, since odds bake in info stats can't see), Poisson elsewhere. With Market Odds selected, every team card also gets a 🧠 Market Engine button that, on demand, ranks the 14 live-priced options for that fixture. None of these are guarantees.

🎯 Step 3: Betting Configuration ▼

(double-tap the header above to collapse/expand this section)
🤖 Auto Configuration Engine
Analyses your extracted teams (odds, league positions, points gaps, opponents, markets, Odds Scores, venues) and sets the whole configuration for you. Advanced mode also learns from the results of the configurations you track, groups the pool into strength tiers and searches many configurations for the best one. Date and kick-off filters are left as you set them. You can undo it.
Teams with odds lower than this value will be excluded from betting slips. Together with the maximum below this forms the team odds range.
Teams with odds higher than this value will be excluded from betting slips
Odds Score is the model's confidence (5-95) for the bet each team's odds are attached to, as shown on the team card. When a score limit is set, teams whose score can't be worked out yet are excluded.
Filter teams based on where they're playing their next match
When enabled, only include teams playing on the selected date
When enabled, only include teams playing between these two dates (inclusive). Works independently of the exact Date Filter above.
When enabled, only include teams whose kick-off time (UTC+3) falls between these two times (inclusive). Leave one side blank for an open-ended range. If "From" is later than "To" the range wraps past midnight (e.g. 20:00 to 02:00). Works together with the date filters above.
When enabled, teams with match dates in the past will be excluded from betting slips
Auto engine ignores your own odds, suggestions and earlier engine picks: when you press Generate, the generator runs the Market Engine itself on every team it can analyse (API Auto-fetch on, opponent and venue known, upcoming match), then for each team takes the best-ranked option that fits your other settings here (Bet Market Filter, team odds limits, Odds Score range). Teams it can't analyse, or with no option that fits, are skipped. Uses API calls for teams not analysed in the last 30 minutes.
Suggested bets come from "Suggest a Bet" on each team card (teams without a suggestion are skipped in Suggested mode). Engine predictions are the picks of the Market Engine: use the card's engine button (or the button below) first; teams without a confident pick are skipped.
Choose "Specific leagues only" to build slips from just the leagues you tick. The list shows every league currently in your teams; a league added later is left unticked until you tick it.
Only include teams whose own league position is between these two positions (inclusive), e.g. 1 to 6 for the top six. Leave one side blank for an open-ended range.
Only include teams whose opponent's league position is between these two positions (inclusive), e.g. 15 to 20 for bottom-of-the-table opponents. Teams with no opponent set, or whose opponent isn't in your extracted teams, are excluded while this is on.
Point difference = the table leader's points minus the team's points (the leader is 0). Only include teams whose gap to their league leader is between these two values (inclusive), e.g. 0 to 6 for teams within 6 points of the top. Leave one side blank for an open-ended range.
Same measure, applied to the opponent: how many points the opponent is behind its league leader. Teams with no opponent set, or whose opponent can't be found, are excluded while this is on.
Choose "Selected markets only" and tick one or more markets from the odds inspector list (full time, 1st half and 2nd half; more lines appear as odds are loaded) to build slips only from teams whose bet is one of them. A 1X2 bet counts as Home Win for a home team and Away Win for an away team; markets outside these 14 (Handicap, Clean Sheet, Team Over...) are left out while this filter is on
Slips are built with a number of teams between the minimum and maximum (inclusive), e.g. 3 to 5 gives trebles, 4-folds and 5-folds. With the switch off there is no limit. Choosing a minimum above the maximum (or the reverse) moves the other box to match.
Current Mode: Teams can appear on multiple slips, generating more betting combinations.

✍️ Build Your Own Slip

Make slips by hand, without the Betting Configuration filters. Open a team card's Market Engine and press "➕ Add to slip" in its prediction box or on any ranked option (press it again to remove it). You can keep several slips and save each one.

📈 Performance Tracking

Track how the saved configurations (pages) perform. Add the pages you care about, name them, and press Update to check their results. Tracked records are kept on this device until you remove them or choose to include them in Reset Everything.
Everything is saved in this browser only. If you open the file from another place, another copy, a private tab or an in-app preview, it starts empty - Export a backup now and then, Import it there.
Ticked: Reset Everything leaves View Saved Slips untouched. Unticked: it deletes them too. You can always delete a page, a slip, or everything yourself from View Saved Slips.
